title: Configure foundryvtt
description: Configure the Foundry Virtual Tabletop module

host.title: Host name
host.description: Fully qualified domain name under which Foundry VTT is published. Foundry binds the license to this host, so pick it before activating the license.

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate for the host name.

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection
http2https.description: Redirect all HTTP requests to HTTPS.

admin_key.title: Administrator access key
admin_key.description: Password that protects the Foundry setup/configuration screen (FOUNDRY_ADMIN_KEY). Leave empty to disable admin protection.

auth_method.title: Software download method
auth_method.description: How the Foundry software is fetched on first start: with your foundryvtt.com account, or with a timed presigned download URL.

foundry_username.title: Foundry account (username or e-mail)
foundry_username.description: foundryvtt.com account used to download the software and fetch a license (FOUNDRY_USERNAME). Required when download method is 'credentials'.

foundry_password.title: Foundry account password
foundry_password.description: Password for the foundryvtt.com account (FOUNDRY_PASSWORD). Required when download method is 'credentials'.

release_url.title: Presigned release URL
release_url.description: Timed download URL copied from your foundryvtt.com profile (FOUNDRY_RELEASE_URL). Used when download method is 'release_url'.

license_key.title: License key
license_key.description: Foundry license key in AAAA-BBBB-CCCC-... form (FOUNDRY_LICENSE_KEY). Optional: if empty and account credentials are given, a license is fetched automatically.

foundry_version.title: Foundry version
foundry_version.description: Specific Foundry version to install, e.g. 13.347 (FOUNDRY_VERSION). Leave empty to use the image default (latest stable).

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: TZ database name for scheduling and log timestamps, e.g. Europe/Berlin.
